content.what_it_is: fluxes.F의 23 subroutines+2 functions와 derivatives.F의 10 subroutines를 전수 읽어 FUNWAVE-TVD flux path를 정리한 노트이다(1-12행). HIGH_ORDER dispatcher, six HLL Riemann fluxes, wave speeds, second/fourth-order MUSCL, MLP, WENO5, vanLeer/minmod reconstruction과 dispersive U4/V4 coupling을 열거한다(14-36행). 분산항용 second/fourth derivative stencils, suspected YY_HIGH index bug, call hierarchy를 제시한다(38-61행).
entities: FLUX_AT_INTERFACE_HLL six-flux calculator and HLL Riemann solver (lines 19-20)

equations.expr: FxL=Gamma3 PL(UxL+Gamma1 U4xL)+0.5g(EtaR^2 Gamma3+2 EtaR Depth)

calls: FLUXES dispatches CONSTRUCTION family by HIGH_ORDER (line 18)
dispersion.F and SGS diffusion call DERIVATIVE_* outside fluxes (line 57)
unresolved: left-state flux is assembled from PL, UxL, and U4xL but its hydrostatic term uses EtaR twice (line 36). The L/R suffix mismatch is a likely copy-paste or interface-side error; whether source should use EtaL requires original code adjudication.
VANLEER_LIMITER divides by |A|+|B| (line 33). For A=B=0 the displayed formula is 0/0; no zero-denominator branch is described.

the first-derivative stencil labeled fourth-order is [U(i+2)+2U(i+1)-U(i-2)-2U(i-1)]/(8DX) (line 44). Taylor expansion has a nonzero cubic moment, so the written stencil is only second-order accurate; either the formula transcription or the order label is inconsistent.
DERIVATIVE_YY_HIGH reportedly reads Uin(I+2,J+2) in a y-second-derivative routine (line 47). This mixes x and y indices and is explicitly a suspected range/copy error requiring source confirmation.

HIGH_ORDER else maps to second-order vanLeer and named prefixes map FOU/FMI/WEN/MLP (line 18), but accepted full strings and invalid-value handling are not given; an unrecognized typo silently selecting second order is possible from the described dispatcher.
